text:
Nice detailed review - as always :) 

The one thing I don't really see anyone mentioning is the actual clock (due to GPU boost), I noticed in all your charts they list the speced boost clock (1733MHz) but in the throttling test its closer to 1800MHz was this because of an overclock or was this what GPU boost actually runs it at during the benchmarks, I remember in the past GPU boost basically meant not every card was exactly the same (eg my GTX970 G1 is speced at 1329MHz but runs over 1400MHz with no manual overclock) and I'm surprised no-ones taking note of the clocks during benches these days even if it will only amount to a small FPS difference.

I gotta say the thing that has me really excited (other than all the VR improvements) is the amount of head room between GP104 and GP100... with nearly half the transistors there's a lot of untapped potential there, even if the GTX1080ti only unlocks 75% of that its still a sizable chunk to look forward to :D
